name: Canaanites The
overview: The Canaanites, descended from Ham, comprised seven distinct nations including the Sidonites, Jebusites, Amorites, and others, as detailed in Genesis 10:15-18. God called Abram to leave his country and kindred to dwell in the land that would become the possession of his descendants, a land previously inhabited by the Canaanites (Genesis 12:1). This land was fertile and great, yet the Canaanites were idolatrous and accursed, leading to their partial expulsion by Israel. Scripture reveals both the kindness of the Canaanites to the patriarchs and the spiritual testing Israel faced by dwelling among them, emphasizing the call to avoid their customs, idols, and intermarriage.
